data.name: ContributionModeLabel
data.value: Contribution Mode
data.comment: Field label on the Metaverse attribute editor.

data.name: ContributionModePriority
data.value: Priority
data.comment: A contribution mode: the highest-priority contributor supplies the values.

data.name: ContributionModeAccumulate
data.value: Accumulate
data.comment: A contribution mode: every contributor adds values, and none is removed. An imperative verb, as a mode name.

data.name: ContributionModeHelper
data.value: How the values of several Synchronisation Rules are combined. Priority takes them from the highest-priority contributor; Accumulate adds every value and never removes one through synchronisation; Merge adds every value and removes one once no contributor supplies it.
data.comment: Helper text under the Contribution Mode field. Priority and Accumulate are the mode names (ContributionModePriority, ContributionModeAccumulate).

data.name: ContributionModeReferenceHelper
data.value: Accumulate and Merge are not available for a Reference attribute, because a reference is removed with the Metaverse Object it points to. To keep a history of references, record them as text in a separate attribute.
data.comment: Helper text under the Contribution Mode field when the attribute is a Reference attribute.

data.name: AccumulateNotice
data.value: From each Metaverse Object's next synchronisation, every contributor adds its values to this attribute, and synchronisation never removes one, even after the account that supplied it is deleted.
data.comment: Notice shown when an administrator changes an attribute to Accumulate, before saving.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateNotice
data.value: At each Metaverse Object's next synchronisation, the values this attribute kept that no contributor supplies any more are removed, and exports remove them from target systems.
data.comment: Warning shown when an administrator changes an attribute from Accumulate to another mode, before saving.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateDialogTitle
data.value: Stop accumulating values in '{0}'?
data.comment: Title of the confirmation dialog. {0} is the attribute's name.

data.name: LeaveAccumulateWarning
data.value: Changing {0} to {1} removes, at each Metaverse Object's next synchronisation, the values that no contributor supplies any more, and exports then remove them from target systems. They cannot be recovered.
data.comment: {0} attribute name, rendered as inline code so no quotes; {1} the contribution mode

data.name: LeaveAccumulateConfirm
data.value: Stop accumulating
data.comment: Confirm button of the dialog.

data.name: PriorityListAccumulateNotice
data.value: This attribute uses the Accumulate contribution mode: every Synchronisation Rule below adds its values and none is preferred, so there is no order to set, and "Null is a value" has no effect.
data.comment: Shown above an Accumulate attribute's contributors, where a Priority attribute shows its priority order. "Null is a value" is a setting's name.

data.name: PendingContributorThisMapping
data.value: this mapping, once saved
data.comment: Stands in the Synchronisation Rule column for the mapping being created, which has no rule row yet.

data.name: ColumnConnectedSystem
data.value: Connected System
data.comment: Column heading.

data.name: ColumnSynchronisationRule
data.value: Synchronisation Rule
data.comment: Column heading.

data.name: NullIsValueAccumulateTooltip
data.value: "Null is a value" has no effect on an Accumulate attribute: every contributor adds its values, so there is no winner for a missing value to override.
data.comment: Tooltip on the disabled "Null is a value" switch in the Attribute Flow editor.

data.name: ExportAccumulateAdvisory
data.value: This Metaverse attribute accumulates values, so this Attribute Flow exports every value it has kept, including those from accounts that have since been deleted.
data.comment: Advisory in the Attribute Flow editor when an outbound flow's source attribute uses the Accumulate mode.

data.name: ContributionModeMerge
data.value: Merge

data.name: MergeNotice
data.value: From each Metaverse Object's next synchronisation, every contributor adds its values to this attribute, and a value is removed only once no contributor supplies it.

data.name: PriorityListMergeNotice
data.value: This attribute uses the Merge contribution mode: every Synchronisation Rule below adds its values and none is preferred, so there is no order to set, and "Null is a value" has no effect.

data.name: NullIsValueMergeTooltip
data.value: "Null is a value" has no effect on a Merge attribute: every contributor adds its values, so there is no winner for a missing value to override.

data.name: ImpactLosingOne
data.value: At least {0} Metaverse Object will lose values at its next synchronisation.
data.comment: {0} count

data.name: ImpactLosingOther
data.value: At least {0} Metaverse Objects will lose values at their next synchronisation.
data.comment: {0} count

data.name: ImpactLosingWithValuesOne
data.value: At least {0} Metaverse Object will lose values at its next synchronisation, among them {1} values no contributor supplies any more.
data.comment: {0} object count, {1} value count

data.name: ImpactLosingWithValuesOther
data.value: At least {0} Metaverse Objects will lose values at their next synchronisation, among them {1} values no contributor supplies any more.
data.comment: {0} object count, {1} value count

data.name: ImpactKeepingOneOne
data.value: {0} Metaverse Object holds values from several contributors and will keep only the highest-priority one's.
data.comment: {0} count

data.name: ImpactKeepingOneOther
data.value: {0} Metaverse Objects hold values from several contributors and will keep only the highest-priority one's.
data.comment: {0} count

data.name: ImpactGainingOne
data.value: {0} Metaverse Object will gain values from contributors it holds no values from today.
data.comment: {0} count

data.name: ImpactGainingOther
data.value: {0} Metaverse Objects will gain values from contributors they hold no values from today.
data.comment: {0} count

data.name: ImpactNone
data.value: No Metaverse Object's values change.
data.comment: Shown when a change of contribution mode moves no value
